title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO (Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator) is a type of linear regression that uses shrinkage. Shrinkage is where data values are shrunk towards a central point, like the mean. The LASSO procedure encourages simple, sparse models (i.e., models with fewer parameters).

title: Effect of LASSO on Model Complexity
text: LASSO regularization can reduce the complexity of a model by setting some coefficients to zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Impact on MSE on Held-out Test Data
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO might affect the model's performance on unseen data. A simpler model might generalize better, potentially reducing the MSE on held-out test data.
